comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reviewed 3ed37eb..b6a60c2 against the watched diff, SCXML source, changelog, Hackage 0.9.1.0 and v0.9.1.0 tag. No catalog change for tooling, Cabal formatting or guide profile changes. Record through 127d348 only: descriptive SCXML export and its label/validation rules exist after that point but remain unreleased; existing published Mermaid/inspector standards remain correct. Revisit the diagram concept when the export is published.

Reconciled c68dbdd7..e6ef560b against watched source/SQL/API diffs, generated harness/fold/replay logic, all seven Hackage 0.21.0.0 packages and matching release tags. Correct existing concepts: current Kiroku/Shibuya/PGMQ/Effectful cohort; bounded sampled snapshot verification; typed subscription startup and deterministic decode failures; atomic stopped checkpoint/lease resize; guarded catalog command rollback and callback restrictions; mapped initial/write-lift construction and used-lift fold evidence; strict scalar contract lists and identity-key refusal; whole-name helpers; history-backed initial-hole witnesses; removal reports and registry-aware binding-view schema checks. Existing concepts absorb these capabilities; no new Keiro concept. No catalog runtime change for supporting plans, fixtures, release/build automation or internal replay-evidence refactoring beyond the corrected rules. Keiro SQL payloads remain unchanged, but Kiroku 0012-0015 cutovers apply. Correct test-layout and migration testing for same-database resource pools and durable/exclusively-leased benchmark fixtures. Source contradicts prose claiming mori://shinzui/keiro/plans/300-poll-pgmq-client-side-for-long-poll-job-workers-to-fix-bug-4-and-bug-6 shipped: Job.toPollingConfig still maps LongPoll to adapter LongPolling; require PollEvery and document the verified defect rather than assuming client-side polling.

Reconciled 758b81a..ad866f9 against Store, subscription worker/FSM, publisher, SQL, migrations 0012-0015, inspection/provider/wire modules, adapter and release changelogs; Hackage and cohort tags at 7394055 verified. Correct existing append/head, decode-hook, subscription capacities/target binding/topology/retry/stall, adapter ownership/guard and telemetry rules; route stopped-writer and stopped-subscription cutovers plus transactional index-build blocking. Create kiroku/inspection for public bounded browsing, exact cursors, durable dead-letter reads, provider discovery, standalone/process scope, CORS and recoverable tails. No further catalog change for benchmark/test scaffolding, manifests, release evidence or plan/status prose; finite performance acceptance is not a general throughput guarantee.

Reviewed 7512b5c..0967f45; reconcile the published 0.10.0.1 cohort through tag de42f07 (Hackage core and metrics verified). Correct processing, gotchas and Kubernetes rules for startup ownership, duplicate/concurrency validation, retained finalization failure, progress-based health, bounded graceful shutdown and separately bounded batch-key cardinality. Create messaging/shibuya-inspection for released lifecycle, loopback host, resource settings, dependency deadlines and terminal WebSocket frames. Retain the watermark at de42f07: later explicit browser/CORS policy, outbound admission/send bounds, detailed latency/progress, intake controls and telemetry lifetime/cancellation work remain unpublished. The inspection concept explicitly separates those capabilities from 0.10.0.1; supporting plans and benchmark evidence do not add published guarantees.

Reviewed 8fff5fb..48a1ed0 against changelogs, library/effect source and migration package bounds; Hackage family 0.6.1.1 and v0.6.1.1 tag at 696b6bd verified. Correct existing reconciliation/cohort guidance for pg-migrate 1.2 admission without SQL or production API changes. Keep released disconnect behavior accurate and identify the implemented companion as unreleased. No catalog runtime change for stable ephemeral-PG roots and release/test tooling. Stop at 696b6bd: later receive-side disconnect classification/isAmbiguousReply and non-destructive queue/archive inspection with five new effect constructors are unpublished; revisit retry and inspection standards on release.

Reviewed 8a528b6..1386505; verified 1.2.0.0 Hackage test-support and upstream tag. Correct migration model and testing for defaultEphemeralConfig, stable per-user cleanup root, ephemeral-pg 0.3.1 and coordinated 1.2 release. Production source, ledger, migration payloads and APIs unchanged. Keiro 0.18 still constrains the 1.1/kiroku-migrations 0.4 cohort; do not force latest independent packages together.
Reviewed b326814..384f112: no runtime source or release change. No catalog change: capability catalog documents existing behavior, guide/ADR provenance and profiles plus Nix/skill tooling only.

Reconciled 392f754..237575e against finalizer source, changelogs, Hackage 0.16.1.0 and v0.16.1.0 tag at 6ce44ab. Correct jobs, connection-faults, transport/gotcha and deployment guidance for source-row-claimed transactional DLQ recovery, serialized cancellation-safe acknowledgement and surfaced PgmqAcknowledgementException. Correct the standing polling rule from source plus mori://shinzui/shibuya-pgmq-adapter/okf/bug-reports/concepts/BUG-1 and mori://shinzui/shibuya-pgmq-adapter/okf/bug-reports/concepts/BUG-4 evidence: LongPolling still issues server read_with_poll and can starve acknowledgements or outlive a killed client; prefer StandardPolling / Keiro PollEvery. No new concept: existing jobs/faults standards cover both defects. No runtime catalog change after the release for telemetry/lifecycle test fixtures and stable ephemeral-PG roots.
